nodes.label: linter Sensor
nodes.rationale: Wraps the project's configured linter (eslint default at v0.5.0) on TS/JS outputs, echoing Fowler's Eslint/Semgrep harness-engineering examples. Multi-language auto-detection (ruff, golangci-lint, clippy) is deferred to v0.6.0+ and carried forward as reading the project type from the practices Tech Stack section.

nodes.label: SENSOR_FAILED Audit Event
nodes.rationale: The common failure surface for every sensor: the event carries an 8-hex fire-id correlator matching the SENSOR_FIRED row in the active record's audit shard, and the structured detail is written under the intent's .aidlc-sensors/<stage-slug>/<sensor>-<fire-id>.md so the finding is inspectable without inflating the audit row.
